Plot a game or a battle

Source: R/plot.R
autoplot.rk_game.Rd

ggplot2::autoplot() methods: an rk_game is drawn as the world map (see rk_plot_map()), an rk_battle as the armies remaining after each duel.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'rk_game'
autoplot(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'rk_battle'
autoplot(object, ...)

Arguments

object

An rk_game or an rk_battle.

...

Passed on to rk_plot_map() for rk_game; not used for rk_battle.

Value

A ggplot object.

See also

Other plots: rk_plot_conquest(), rk_plot_duel(), rk_plot_map(), rk_plot_odds_heatmap(), rk_plot_tournament()

Examples

game <- rk_game(c("Red", "Blue"), seed = 1)
ggplot2::autoplot(game)


set.seed(1)
ggplot2::autoplot(rk_battle(12, 10))
